fields.name: api_key
fields.help: CustomCat API key (generated per 'API Custom Integrations' store; Settings in the app shows a read-only and a read-write key — create_order needs the read-write one), sent as the `api_key` parameter.

config_fields.name: sandbox
config_fields.help: Set to 1 to send `sandbox: 1` with create_order and get_order (CustomCat's sandbox flag); left out when unset, so orders are real and charged.

me.note: CustomCat has no account endpoint; the probe lists the catalogue categories ([{category, category_url_slug, subcategories}]), so `account` is empty on success.

list_products.note: GET /product: the products you set up in CustomCat ({products[{product{product_id, title, product_type, description, options, variants[{sku, title, price, cost, instock, option1, option2}]}}]}); `sku`/`price` are the first variant's. `query` and `category` are not accepted. The blank catalogue (GET /catalog) is not mapped.

create_order.note: POST /order/{order_id} submits a real, charged order (unless the sandbox setting is 1) under a fresh UUID order id, which get_order and track take. `shipping_address` is {first_name, last_name, email, phone, address1, address2, city, state, zip, country (ISO-2)} (all but address2 required); `items` are [{sku, quantity}] for products made in CustomCat or [{catalog_sku, design_url, design_url_back, quantity}]; `shipping_option` is the shipping_method name from GET /shipping (required by CustomCat).

get_order.note: GET /order/status/{order_id} (your order id): {ORDER_ID, CUSTOMCAT_ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS (Pending, Verified, Shipped), ORDER_TOTAL, ORDER_DATE, SHIPMENTS[{TRACKING_ID, METHOD, VENDOR}], LINE_ITEMS[{STATUS, PRODUCT_NAME}]}. ORDER_DATE is a text date such as 'March, 27 2018 12:14:45'.

track.note: The SHIPMENTS[{TRACKING_ID, METHOD, VENDOR, NUMBER_ITEMS}] of GET /order/status/{order_id}; one event per shipment.

not_offered.get_product: GET /product/{product_id} is listed but its response is not documented (only the /product list response is), so no field mapping can be grounded in the docs.
not_offered.quote_shipping: GET /shipping lists methods for a country and POST /shipping/{shipping_id} prices items[{catalog_sku, quantity}] for one method, but neither response shape is documented, so no options list can be mapped.
